actions.create_deployment.description: Create a deployment for an existing Vercel project using either a redeploy source deployment ID or a git source payload.
actions.create_deployment.props.deployme: Choose whether to redeploy a previous deployment or deploy from a connected Git source.
actions.create_deployment.props.force_ne: Create a new deployment even if a previous similar deployment exists.
actions.create_deployment.props.skip_aut: Automatically confirm framework detection without prompting.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to Vercel. The Authorization header is injected automatically. If your connection uses Team ID or Team Slug, add `teamId` or `slug` manually in the URL or Query Parameters for team-scoped requests.
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.queryParam: Optional query parameters. For team-scoped requests, manually include `teamId` or `slug` here when needed.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_deployment_status.descriptio: Retrieve a deployment and inspect its current status.
actions.list_environment_variables.descr: Retrieve environment variables for a Vercel project.
actions.list_environment_variables.props: Deprecated by Vercel. If enabled, Vercel will attempt to return decrypted values when allowed.
Optional branch filter. Only valid for preview-scoped variables.
actions.list_projects.description: Retrieve all Vercel projects for the authenticated user or team.
actions.upsert_environment_variable.desc: Create or update a Vercel environment variable using Vercel's upsert API.
actions.upsert_environment_variable.prop: Optional note describing the variable usage.
Optional branch. Only valid when Preview is one of the selected targets.
Environment(s) where this variable should apply.
auth.description: Authenticate with a Vercel personal access token. Optionally provide a team ID or team slug to operate on team-owned resources.
auth.props.slug.description: Optional. Team slug. Ignored when Team ID is provided.
auth.props.teamId.description: Optional. Use this to target a specific Vercel team.
auth.props.token.description: Create a token in Vercel Settings → Tokens.
description: Deploy projects and manage environment variables on Vercel.
